title: Synergistic effects of the curcumin analog HO-3867 and olaparib in transforming fallopian tube epithelial cells.
authors: Tseng, Cai-Chieh; Ku, Min-Hsi; Wu, Wei-Min; Mendez, Ava; Christner, Tessa; Wu, Yun-Chieh; Huang, Wei-Lun; Chen, Yu-Hsiang; Huang, Ching-Wen; Barefoot, Johnathan; Chen, Chi-Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素类似物HO-3867与奥拉帕尼在卵巢癌中的协同抗肿瘤作用，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-p53蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ovarian cancer remains one of the most lethal gynecologic malignancies, largely due to high recurrence rates and treatment-related toxicities. Although PARP inhibitors like Olaparib have shown efficacy in BRCA-mutated cancers, their benefit is limited in broader patient populations. TP53 mutations, highly prevalent in ovarian cancer, promote tumor progression and resistance, making p53 a key therapeutic target. This study evaluated the anticancer potential of HO-3867, a curcumin analog known to restore mutant p53 function, alone and in combination with Olaparib. We used fallopian tube-derived ovarian cancer models harboring mutant or null TP53 and analyzed TP53 expression and mutation profiles using TCGA datasets. Molecular docking simulations and cellular thermal shift assays (CETSA) confirmed HO-3867 binding to the p53(Y220C) mutant core domain. Cytotoxicity was assessed via SRB assays; flow cytometry and Western blotting were used to examine cell cycle progression, apoptosis, and DNA damage. HO-3867 treatment increased phospho-p53 (Ser15) and p21 expression, induced G1 phase arrest, and suppressed cell viability. Notably, co-treatment with Olaparib synergistically enhanced apoptosis, as indicated by increased caspase-3 and PARP1 cleavage and elevated gammaH2AX levels. These findings suggest that HO-3867 reactivates mutant p53 and potentiates Olaparib efficacy by promoting apoptosis and amplifying DNA damage, offering a promising therapeutic strategy for TP53-mutant ovarian cancer.
abstract_zh: 卵巢癌仍是最致命的妇科恶性肿瘤之一，主要归因于高复发率和治疗相关毒性。尽管PARP抑制剂如奥拉帕尼（Olaparib）在BRCA突变型癌症中显示出疗效，但其在更广泛患者群体中的获益有限。TP53突变在卵巢癌中高度普遍，促进肿瘤进展和耐药性，使p53成为关键治疗靶点。本研究评估了姜黄素类似物HO-3867（已知可恢复突变型p53功能）单独及与奥拉帕尼联合使用的抗癌潜力。我们使用携带突变型或缺失型TP53的输卵管来源卵巢癌模型，并利用TCGA数据集分析TP53表达和突变谱。分子对接模拟和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）确认了HO-3867与p53(Y220C)突变核心结构域的结合。通过SRB实验评估细胞毒性；使用流式细胞术和蛋白质印迹法检测细胞周期进程、凋亡和DNA损伤。HO-3867处理增加了磷酸化p53（Ser15）和p21表达，诱导G1期阻滞，并抑制细胞活力。值得注意的是，与奥拉帕尼联合处理协同增强了凋亡，表现为caspase-3和PARP1裂解增加及gammaH2AX水平升高。这些发现表明，HO-3867重新激活突变型p53，并通过促进凋亡和放大DNA损伤增强奥拉帕尼疗效，为TP53突变型卵巢癌提供了一种有前景的治疗策略。
